details.text: `[HIGH]` every `zip 0.6.x` release was yanked on Oct 16 around 03:36 UTC. `sgl-model-gateway` has no committed `Cargo.lock`, so its `npyz` dev-dependency can no longer resolve. **Disconfirming**: (none found). details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: merge #44720, then confirm the Oct 17 scheduled build publishes all 4 flavors. Other image builds that run `maturin` without a lockfile may hit the same error; I did not check them.
